themes_detail.label: Litter Basket Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Litter basket complaints surged to 4 this week versus a baseline of 0.1 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 3,100% spike (z-score: 11.72)—signaling a possible sanitation infrastructure failure or sudden overflow event in Sheepshead Bay/Gravesend this week.

No recent sanitation-related news or community board data available to explain root cause

themes_detail.summary: Dead or dying tree complaints jumped to 8 this week from a 2.5-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 220% spike (z-score: 5.5)—indicating possible disease, storm damage, or neglected street tree maintenance in the district this week.

themes_detail.label: Street Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Dangling street sign complaints reached 5 this week versus a 1.0 weekly baseline over 8 weeks—a 400% spike (z-score: 4.62)—coupled with 775 street condition complaints over 90 days, suggesting accelerating public realm maintenance gaps this week.

Street condition complaints rank 5th overall at 775 complaints over 90 days, indicating systemic issue
reporting_angles: Has DOT deferred routine street furniture inspections due to budget cuts or staffing shortages?

themes_detail.label: Noise Surge Across District
themes_detail.summary: General noise complaints jumped to 40 last week from a 15.4-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks—a 160% spike (z-score: 5.34)—alongside a separate 1,100% spike in house-of-worship noise (3 complaints last week vs. 0.2 avg), suggesting either event-driven noise or enforcement gaps last week.
evidence: 40 general noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 15.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks (160% increase)
3 house-of-worship noise complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1,100% spike, z-score: 6.35)
Noise complaints rank 3rd overall at 1,400 complaints over 90 days
reporting_angles: Did a large community or religious event trigger the spike in worship-related noise last week?
Are NYPD noise enforcement units responding adequately to residential complaints in the district?
